message: Preregistered a from-scratch tokenizer scale study after CR-DEMO-0001 exposed unacceptable visual quality; dynamics remains blocked pending metric and visual gates.
Started the single v2 pipeline on the existing A10 from detached source commit 5ad134f; no old checkpoint is eligible for resume.
Bound the preregistered runner, action contract, structured collector, metrics and adaptive scale rule to the exact source commit before GPU execution.
Structured train and held-out level-disjoint datasets passed cardinality, no-op, action diversity, macro-persistence and tree-hash audits.
Probed exact sizes and native step allocations, then entered fresh n0.17m training as the first fixed-FLOPs arm.
At the user's direction, removed the conditional quality gate: all five scales must train before comparison. The first arm was still training and no held-out result existed.
